description: This PHP class implements an internal calendar provider for SuiteCRM, handling operations such as testing connections, fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving events (meetings, calls, tasks) within SuiteCRM. It interacts with SuiteCRM beans and database entities to manage calendar events tailored to the application's internal calendar system.

classes.name: SuiteCRMInternalCalendarProvider
classes.description: Implements internal calendar operations for SuiteCRM, managing various event types and their synchronization with SuiteCRM database entities.

methods.name: testCalendarConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the SuiteCRM internal calendar by creating a new Meeting bean.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves calendar events (meetings, calls, tasks) for a user based on the provided query.

methods.name: getMeetings
methods.description: Fetches a list of meetings for a user, applying query filters.

methods.name: buildBaseWhereConditions
methods.description: Creates basic WHERE conditions for database queries based on user ID.

methods.name: buildDateConditions
methods.description: Builds date range conditions for filtering database entries.

methods.name: getCalls
methods.description: Retrieves call records for a user based on query parameters.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves task records for a user, excluding completed tasks.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates a new internal meeting event in SuiteCRM based on the provided calendar event data.

methods.name: doUpdateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in SuiteCRM based on the provided calendar event data.

methods.name: findEventBean
methods.description: Finds an event bean (meeting, call, task) in SuiteCRM by target ID.

methods.name: doDeleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event in SuiteCRM identified by target ID.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific calendar event by ID from SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getEventFromBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent object from a SuiteCRM bean based on its type.
